text: Soudal says it is 100% family owned: established in 1966 by founder Vic Swerts, with Soudal Industry managed by the Soudal Group of Turnhout, Belgium.
short: Soudal is 100% family owned (founder Vic Swerts).

source.name: Soudal Industry: About Soudal
source.quote: The company, established in 1966 by Mr Vic Swerts, is 100% family owned.
source.note: Page without a date; footer names SOUDAL NV, Turnhout, and says Soudal Industry is managed by the Soudal Group. Opened 2026-10-01.
